entities.summary: Masoumeh Abad is an Iranian author, university professor, and conservative politician. She was a member of the fourth Islamic City Council of Tehran and its Director of Health Division. Abad is also the author of the book I'm Alive. She was former Iranian Ambassador to Finland from 2023 to 2024.
